```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: log2 proportion ratio bootstrap plots (same style/methodology as
slide 10's original composition plot and `09-bootstrap-test-subtype-proportions.Rmd`),
but using the combined 13-level cell-type/subtype label from
`16-celltype_subtype_composition_barchart.Rmd` - Myocardium/VSMC/Epicardium
as-is, Endocardium and Mesenchyme broken into their subtypes - tested as one
`clusters` variable across the whole dataset (not conditioned on parent cell
type), matching how the original 5-category composition test must have
worked (its source script was never found/tracked - this replicates the
same design with subtypes substituted in for Endocardium/Mesenchyme).

Same pseudo-replicate bootstrap design as `08-bootstrap-test-celltype-proportions-cell-cycle.Rmd` /
`09-bootstrap-test-subtype-proportions.Rmd`: 100 bootstraps, 3
pseudo-replicates per genotype, `speckle::propeller(transform = "asin")`.
Combined (all stages) and by-stage (e11/e12) versions.

**Standalone script** - reads already-saved objects/outputs, does not
modify any existing script.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Build the composite cell-type/subtype label

- Same construction as `16-celltype_subtype_composition_barchart.Rmd`.

```{r build-composite-label}
re_embed_interesting_cells <- readRDS(file.path(main_data_dir, "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(re_embed_interesting_cells, "Seurat"))

subtype_meta <- read_csv(subtype_csv_path) %>%
  dplyr::rename(barcode = `...1`) %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, endocardial_subtype, mesenchyme_subtype)

celltype_cols <- c(
  "Myocardium"  = "#E41A1C",
  "VSMC"        = "#984EA3",
  "Epicardium"  = "#FF7F00",
  "Mesenchyme"  = "#4DAF4A",
  "Endocardium" = "#377EB8"
)

endocardial_order <- c("Ventricular", "Angiogenic", "Valve", "Arterial")
endocardial_cols <- c(
  "Ventricular" = "#66C2A5",
  "Angiogenic"  = "#FC8D62",
  "Valve"       = "#8DA0CB",
  "Arterial"    = "#E78AC3"
)

mesenchyme_order <- c(
  "EndoMT_derived", "EndoMT_derived (proliferating)",
  "E11_NCC", "E11_NCC (proliferating)",
  "E12_NCC_Vegfa", "E12_NCC_Sema3c"
)
mesenchyme_cols <- c(
  "EndoMT_derived"                  = "#1B9E77",
  "EndoMT_derived (proliferating)"  = "#D95F02",
  "E11_NCC"                         = "#7570B3",
  "E11_NCC (proliferating)"         = "#E7298A",
  "E12_NCC_Vegfa"                   = "#66A61E",
  "E12_NCC_Sema3c"                  = "#E6AB02"
)

composite_order <- c("Myocardium", "VSMC", "Epicardium", endocardial_order, mesenchyme_order)

# same per-category palette as 16-celltype_subtype_composition_barchart.Rmd,
# so the bar charts and these bootstrap plots read as one consistent set
composite_cols <- c(
  "Myocardium" = celltype_cols[["Myocardium"]],
  "VSMC"       = celltype_cols[["VSMC"]],
  "Epicardium" = celltype_cols[["Epicardium"]],
  endocardial_cols,
  mesenchyme_cols
)

meta <- re_embed_interesting_cells@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(subtype_meta, by = "barcode") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    composite_celltype = dplyr::case_when(
      new_celltypes == "Endocardium" ~ endocardial_subtype,
      new_celltypes == "Mesenchyme"  ~ mesenchyme_subtype,
      TRUE                           ~ as.character(new_celltypes)
    ),
    composite_celltype = factor(composite_celltype, levels = composite_order)
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(meta$composite_celltype))

# genotype factor levels so PropRatio = Mib1_KO / control, matching the
# established convention from 08-/09-bootstrap-test-*.Rmd
meta$genotype <- factor(meta$genotype, levels = c("Mib1_KO", "control"))

table(meta$composite_celltype, meta$genotype)
```

# Bootstrap helper functions

- Identical logic to `09-bootstrap-test-subtype-proportions.Rmd`.

```{r bootstrap-helpers}
assign_pseudo_replicates_genotype <- function(meta_subset, n_reps, genotypes) {

  pseudo_rep_col <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_subset))

  for (geno in genotypes) {

    idx <- which(meta_subset$genotype == geno)

    if (length(idx) < n_reps) {
      warning(glue::glue(
        "Fewer than {n_reps} cells for genotype {geno} — skipping this group in this bootstrap."
      ))
      next
    }

    sampled_idx <- sample(idx, size = length(idx), replace = TRUE)

    n_keep      <- floor(length(sampled_idx) / n_reps) * n_reps
    sampled_idx <- sampled_idx[seq_len(n_keep)]
    rep_labels  <- rep(
      paste0(geno, "_rep", seq_len(n_reps)),
      each = floor(length(sampled_idx) / n_reps)
    )

    pseudo_rep_col[sampled_idx] <- rep_labels
  }

  return(pseudo_rep_col)
}

run_bootstrap_propeller <- function(meta, cluster_col = "composite_celltype", n_bootstraps = 100, n_pseudoreps = 3) {

  genotypes <- levels(droplevels(meta$genotype))
  meta_sub  <- meta %>%
    dplyr::select(genotype, cluster = dplyr::all_of(cluster_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = droplevels(factor(cluster)))

  raw_boot_list <- vector("list", n_bootstraps)

  for (b in seq_len(n_bootstraps)) {

    pseudo_reps <- assign_pseudo_replicates_genotype(
      meta_subset = meta_sub,
      n_reps      = n_pseudoreps,
      genotypes   = genotypes
    )

    meta_boot <- meta_sub %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pseudo_rep = pseudo_reps) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudo_rep))

    if (nrow(meta_boot) < (n_pseudoreps * length(genotypes))) {
      raw_boot_list[[b]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    prop_result <- tryCatch(
      {
        speckle::propeller(
          clusters  = meta_boot$cluster,
          sample    = meta_boot$pseudo_rep,
          group     = meta_boot$genotype,
          transform = "asin"
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message(glue::glue("    Bootstrap {b} failed: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(prop_result)) {
      prop_result$bootstrap_id <- b
    }

    raw_boot_list[[b]] <- prop_result
  }

  raw_results_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), raw_boot_list))

  summary_df <- raw_results_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_bootstraps_run       = dplyr::n(),
      n_bootstraps_sig_fdr05 = sum(FDR < 0.05,  na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig_fdr05         = mean(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_FDR             = median(FDR,       na.rm = TRUE),
      median_PropRatio       = median(PropRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
      CI_PropRatio_lower     = quantile(PropRatio, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      CI_PropRatio_upper     = quantile(PropRatio, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prop_sig_fdr05))

  list(raw_results = raw_results_df, summary = summary_df)
}

# shared plot builder - identical logic to 09-bootstrap-test-subtype-proportions.Rmd,
# including the non-finite / extreme-outlier filter before plotting
make_bootstrap_plot <- function(raw_results, title, outlier_fence = 3) {

  n_before <- nrow(raw_results)

  raw_results <- raw_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log2PR = log2(PropRatio)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2PR)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q1  = quantile(log2PR, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3  = quantile(log2PR, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q3 - q1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      iqr == 0 | dplyr::between(log2PR, q1 - outlier_fence * iqr, q3 + outlier_fence * iqr)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-q1, -q3, -iqr, -log2PR)

  n_dropped <- n_before - nrow(raw_results)
  if (n_dropped > 0) {
    message(glue::glue(
      "{title}: dropped {n_dropped} bootstrap draw(s) (non-finite or extreme outlier) before plotting"
    ))
  }

  raw_results <- raw_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(BaselineProp.clusters = forcats::fct_reorder(
      BaselineProp.clusters, PropRatio, .fun = median
    ))

  ggplot(
    raw_results,
    aes(x = log2(PropRatio), y = BaselineProp.clusters, fill = BaselineProp.clusters)
  ) +
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(
      adjust        = 0.7,
      width         = 0.6,
      justification = -0.2,
      .width        = c(0.5, 0.95),
      point_colour  = NA,
      alpha         = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = composite_cols, guide = "none") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = expression(Log[2]~"Proportion Ratio (Mib1 KO / Control), 100 bootstraps"),
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

# =============================================================================
# Combined (e11 + e12 pooled)
# =============================================================================

```{r bootstrap-combined, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
combined_result <- run_bootstrap_propeller(meta)

combined_result$summary

saveRDS(
  combined_result,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "16-bootstrap_propeller_celltype_subtype_combined.rds")
)

p_combined <- make_bootstrap_plot(
  combined_result$raw_results,
  title = "Cell-type/subtype proportions — Mib1-KO vs control (e11 + e12 combined)"
)

ggsave(
  plot = p_combined,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-bootstrap_celltype_subtype_combined.png"),
  width = 9, height = 7
)

p_combined
```

# =============================================================================
# By stage (e11, e12 separately)
# =============================================================================

```{r bootstrap-by-stage, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stages <- c("e11", "e12")

by_stage_results <- setNames(
  lapply(stages, function(stg) {
    message(glue::glue("--- Stage: {stg} ---"))
    run_bootstrap_propeller(dplyr::filter(meta, stage == stg))
  }),
  stages
)

purrr::walk(stages, function(stg) print(by_stage_results[[stg]]$summary))

saveRDS(
  by_stage_results,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "16-bootstrap_propeller_celltype_subtype_by_stage.rds")
)

stage_plots <- lapply(stages, function(stg) {
  make_bootstrap_plot(
    by_stage_results[[stg]]$raw_results,
    title = glue::glue("Cell-type/subtype proportions — Mib1-KO vs control ({stg})")
  )
})

p_by_stage <- patchwork::wrap_plots(stage_plots, ncol = 1)

ggsave(
  plot = p_by_stage,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "16-bootstrap_celltype_subtype_by_stage.png"),
  width = 9, height = 14
)

p_by_stage
```
